# `inconsistent-import-alias`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an import alias that differs from the dominant alias for the same module
across the scanned project.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

One module with several local names makes cross-file reading and search
unnecessarily difficult.

## When it fires

A convention requires at least 20 samples and a 90% majority. Generated sources
are excluded.
